newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech Nov real final ind output +1.4 pct (+5.3pct).
newsitem.headline: Czech Nov real final ind output +1.4 pct (+5.3pct).

text.p: Czech real definitive industrial output in November grew by 1.4 percent, year-on-year, putting output for the first 11 months of the year up 7.4 percent, year-on-year, the Czech Statistical Bureau said on Thursday.
It added that average industrial monthly wages grew, in nominal terms, 14.4 percent in November compared with an 18.2 percent rise in October, year-on- year.
INDUSTRIAL OUTPUT NOV/96 OCT/96 JAN-NOV-96 NOV/95

NOTE. Preliminary estimates in brackets. The average nominal industrial wage in November was 11,682 crowns compared with 10,202 in October. The November index of real wages was up 5.3 percent, while the real wage index was 7.6 percent higher for the first 11 months of the year.
Wage results sample companies with 100 or more employees while output results include estimates of smaller firms as well.
